minutes.headline: Finance Committee agreed to rework capital planning this summer after Town Meeting; approved three sets of minutes.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the town manager's grant and project updates, then reviewed Town Meeting, focusing on the capital plan article and the 30 School Street amendment. They discussed goals and summer topics including capital planning, budget presentation standards, a debt session and a tax discussion, approved minutes, and set June 9 on Zoom.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee generally agreed that the chair should pursue offline talks with the town manager and town counsel on reforming the capital planning process.
The committee will update its goals and procedures document for FY24, with summer workshop meetings.
Summer topics set: the capital plan process, policies on budget presentations, a debt session with the financial advisor, and a tax discussion.
The committee reviewed Town Meeting, including the capital plan article and the amended 30 School Street article, and heard the town manager's grant and project updates.
The June 9 meeting will be held by Zoom only because the town hall meeting room is unavailable.

why_it_matters: The way the town plans and presents capital spending, and how debt is explained, may change this summer, which shapes the capital and borrowing articles residents are asked to vote on at future Town Meetings.
No vote on capital planning was taken; the committee agreed only to pursue the work, so any change depends on talks that have not yet happened.
